name: Puretrop Fruits Limited
about: Puretrop Fruits Limited engages in the export of processed fruits and vegetables to supermarket chains in India and internationally. It also sells mango, pomegranate, guava, and watermelon pulps and concentrates; and cold extracted fruit/vegetable juices and nut milk. In addition, the company offers tomato and gooseberry pulps, as well as frozen and frozen HPP pomegranate, mango, and guava pulp; and organic. The company was formerly known as Freshtrop Fruits Limited and changed its name to Puretrop Fruits Limited in October 2024. Puretrop Fruits Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
